hint.mendikotChaseTen: A ten is on the table. Go for this trick.

tutorial.tens: Mendikot is decided by neither points nor tricks but by **how many of the four tens you take**. **Three of them wins the hand outright.** The figure above is that race.
tutorial.trump: **There is no step where anyone chooses trump.** The suit is fixed by whatever card the first player who cannot follow chooses to play -- so you cannot pretend to be void in the suit you want.
tutorial.mendikot: Only a two-apiece split falls back to the trick count. **All four tens is a Mendikot, worth 2**; **all thirteen tricks is a Whitewash, worth 3.**
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Playable cards get a green ring. When your partner (T0) already has the trick, put a ten on it.

warn.setsTrump: The suit you play now becomes the trump for this hand — you cannot follow
